== Biography ==

Đặng '''"Kati"''' Thanh Phê started his career at [[New Power Esports]] in the VCSB before joining the VCS. Being a substitute behind [[Optimus]], he would finally make his professional debut in the VCS on [[Sky Gaming]]. Kati is praised for his calm and collective playstyle with a variety of champions in his arsenal.

===2020 Season===

'''Kati''' would end up as starting mid laner for [[Team Flash.Vietnam||Team Flash]] after Optimus retired from professional play. In his rookie split, he would win the [[VCS/2020 Season/Spring Playoffs|Spring Playoffs]] 3-2 against [[GAM Esports]]. After a tremendous split, he won the rookie of the split award. Continuing on in the [[VCS/2020 Season/Summer Season|Summer]], his team would finish 2nd in the regular season and win the [[VCS/2020 Season/Summer Playoffs|Summer Playoffs]] 3-2 against [[GAM Esports]] once again.

Despite having qualified for [[2020 Season World Championship]], Kati could not attend with his team due to COVID-19 regulations as Vietnamese teams were not allowed to travel. 

===2021 Season===

After the 2020 Season, '''Kati''' has signed for [[GAM Esports]] as their new mid laner.

== Trivia ==
*He was awarded the title of National Sports Master by the Ministry of Sports, Culture and Tourism of Vietnam after winning the Gold Medal with the [[Vietnam (National Team)|Vietnam National Team]] at the [[Sea Games 31|31st SEA Games]] at the end of 2022.
*He was awarded the title of National Esports Grandmaster by VIRESA (Vietnam Esports Federation) after achieving good results with [[GAM Esports]] at [[2023_Season_World_Championship|Worlds 2023]] and with [[Vietnam (National Team)|Vietnam National Team]] at [[2022 Asian Games]]  on January 21, 2024.
*Nicknamed "Phê cơ", from his given name "Phê" and "Faker".
